name: Zarzuela (Spain)
description: Quartered, the first and fourth red and the second and third blue with white wavy stripes, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Zarzuela (a tree, a bramble and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Zarzuela; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: wavy stripes on the blue quarters
